system.description:
Noted for their brilliant colors and dancing fins, the Tiny coralcampus has the foreparts of a horse, a fin-like mane, and a long, fish- like tail. Found in the coral reefs of shallow seas, they are often frolicking among schools of brightly-colored tropical fish that share their habitat. A coralcampus’s dazzling colors aren’t just for show, however—they serve as a warning. A DC 14 Nature check recalls that the spines of their fins contain a potent toxin that can temporarily paralyze potential predators.

Adventurers attempting to harvest this toxin from a living coralcampus must succeed on a DC 16 Animal Handling check to safely handle it long enough to extract one instance of coralcampus venom, detailed below:

Coralcampus Venom

Uncommon, contact, instantaneous (cost: 300 gp)

The venom of the coralcampus’s spines is a pale yellow and quite viscous despite its point of origin. When a creature comes into contact with it, it must succeed a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become paralyzed for the next minute. A creature paralyzed in this way may repeat their saving throw at the end of each of their turns.
